name: Kobayashi Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
summary: Kobayashi Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells OTC pharmaceuticals, guasi-drugs, deodorizing air fresheners, and sanitary products in Japan, the United States, Southeast Asia, and internationally. The company offers Ammeltz, an anti-inflammatory pain relief medicine; Dent, an effervescent denture cleaning agent; Ekitai Bluelet Okudake, a toilet bowl cleaner; Naicitol, a Chinese herbal medicine that promotes the breakdown and metabolism of fat; BreathCare, an oral breath freshener capsule; Netsusama sheet, a cooling gel sheet; and deodorizing air fresheners, lens cleaners, and oral hygiene products.
